item.title: New superfluid qubit may cut quantum errors 100-fold
item.description: A proposed qubit using superfluid helium could reduce quantum computing error rates by about 100 times by shielding quantum information.

item.title: Giant stick insect misled scientists for decades
item.description: Researchers identified two new species of large Australian stick insects, one of which lays unusual lidded eggs never previously recorded.
